answer.book: A Basel dissertation of 1649 in Latin, built as one work: a dedication to the faculty, seven numbered questions on justification with their answers, a numbered section rejecting heresies, corollaries, and two appended confessions (Helvetic and Basel).

entries.title: 3. Quæst. An Justitiæ ac Veritati Dei sit consentaneum, Deum justificare impium?
4. Quæst. Quid sit illud, per quod, seu quo, justificamur?
5. Quæst. Quo sensu, In sanguine Christi justificari dicamur?
6. Quæst. Quo modo, & Quâ ratione justificemur?
7. Quæst. Per quid nobis innotescat, Deum nos justificâsse in Christo?
Confessio Helvetica, art. xv. De Justificatione
